summary: DIRTT Environmental Solutions filed a routine Form 8-K reporting receipt of the final C$5.0 million disbursement on September 18, 2026, completing the full C$15.0 million gross commitment under its secured term loan BDC Facility with Business Development Bank of Canada. The facility matures April 30, 2032 and bears interest at BDC's floating base rate less 0.75%. Concurrently, Royal Bank of Canada issued a one-year, auto-renewing C$3.5 million standby letter of credit in favor of BDC, drawable on demand. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated; this is a financing/credit event, not a special situation.
